Optimized streaming LtHash adder with batched BLAKE3 hashing and Solana account support.

# Purpose
`fd_lthash_adder.h` defines an aligned streaming helper for LtHash updates. It stores pending inputs in a batch and uses BLAKE3 hashing, with SIMD batch functions when available, to add values to an `fd_lthash_value_t` sum. The file provides `fd_lthash_adder_new` and [`fd_lthash_adder_delete`](<#fd_lthash_adder_delete>) for setup and teardown, [`fd_lthash_adder_push`](<#fd_lthash_adder_push>) for generic inputs, and [`fd_lthash_adder_flush`](<#fd_lthash_adder_flush>) to commit any queued items. It also provides [`fd_lthash_adder_push_solana_account`](<#fd_lthash_adder_push_solana_account>), which builds the hashed input from Solana account fields such as `lamports`, `data`, `executable`, `owner`, and `pubkey`.
